card.name: Just before the word architect
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation right before an expected 'architect' or 'architecture', such as 'an', a comma in a list of artists' trades, a hyphen after 'painter', or 'trained as'. It appears in art-history and biography text.

modes.label: Trade lists
modes.description: Commas or linking words in lists of a person's crafts, where architect is likely to come next or has just been named.
modes.example: I. Giuliano Di Sangallo (1445-1516) was an architect, sculptor<<,>> tarsiatore and military engineer.

modes.label: Becoming an architect
modes.description: Words such as 'as', 'an' or 'engaged' just before a person is called an architect.
modes.example: where he trained<< as>> an architect after studying economics in Munich.

modes.label: Architecture book titles
modes.description: The apostrophe inside a French title ending in Architecture.
modes.example: Perrault’s Les Dix Livres d<<’>>Architecture de Vitruve

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict architect and architecture words next, and weakens unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before 'architect' is expected, in biographies of Renaissance artists and builders.
